boundary: This pass establishes three things that need no search: Tallini's q^2-q+1 = 73 is a PUBLISHED bound that supersedes Pass 5658's 80.84 MILP dual bound at q=9; the repo's alpha >= 51 is stored as an integer with NO witness and cannot be re-verified; and the best published general lower bound at q=9 is 2q+1 = 19 because 9 = 3^2 is excluded from the (q^{3/2}+3q-q^{1/2}+3)/3 construction. alpha(W(3,9)) itself is NOT determined here, and the deficit formula q^2-q+1-C(q-2,2) is an interpolation with zero degrees of freedom
